title: Buffers around hospital cities in western Uttar Pradesh
body: A health planner in western Uttar Pradesh mapped the point locations of six cities that have major hospitals: Saharanpur, Muzaffarnagar, Meerut, Ghaziabad, Gautam Budh Nagar and Aligarh. Using the buffer module of a GIS software, she created buffers of 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 kilometres around each city. She then added a layer of villages with their population as attribute data, to count how many people live in each buffer zone. Village Rampur lies inside the 4 km buffer of Meerut, while village Khera lies outside the 10 km buffer of every city. She also plans to draw a 1 km buffer around a chemical factory to estimate the number of households affected by the waste it discharges.
